sections.heading: Section 7
paragraphs: Due Dates & Penalties:
What is the ITR-6 Form?

ITR-6 is the form for filing of Income Tax Returns for companies not claiming exemption under Section 11, as in the prescribed ITR Form Online in India. The charitable or religious trust entities should be filing ITR-7.

In India, misdoing with respect to filing returns or any delinquency can drag the person into much more serious consequences in terms of timely finance and bureaucratic measures. Therefore, the ITR-6 Form is the Income Tax Return form made compulsory for corporate bodies that are not exempt under Section 11 of the Income Tax Act. It is worth knowing the ITR 6 Instructions, eligibility, advantages, documents required, tax issues, and process, whether for domestic companies, foreign companies, or OPCs. The entire process is easy with Services plus.
Companies (domestic/foreign) registered under the Companies Act, 2013 or under any previous company law
Private Limited Company
Public Limited Company
Entities whose income arises from business, profession, capital gain, or other sources (excluding income claiming Section 11 exemptions)
Charitable or religious trusts claiming exemption under Section 11
Any individual declaring personal income
Hindu Undivided Families
Limited Liability Partnerships
The ineligible entities in the above have to file other ITR Forms such as ITR-1, ITR-2, ITR-3, ITR-4, and ITR-5 according to their type of income and structure.
Complying with the Indian taxation laws
Settle matters of loss carry forward without any penalties

What is the ITR 6 Form?
ITR 6 Form is an income tax return form designed for companies, except those that claim exemption under Section 11.
Which companies claim an exemption under Section 11?
Companies having income from property held for charitable or religious purposes can claim an exemption under Section 11.
What is the sequence for filing the ITR 6 Form?
ITR 6 should be filed in the following sequence: Part A, Schedules, Part B, and Verification.
How should I file the ITR 6 Form?
ITR 6 Form must be electronically furnished using Digital Signatures with the Income Tax Department.
What is the due date for filing the ITR-6 Form?

The due date for filing the ITR-6 Form depends on various factors: • Accounts audited under the Income-Tax Act - 31st October of the assessment year • A report in Form No. 3CEB is to be furnished – on 30th November of the assessment year • Other cases where accounts need not be audited - 31st July of the assessment year
